name: Guildmark Arming Sword
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a standalone 3D-intake concept for Guildmark Arming Sword, using the supplied Whetstorm-original armory painting as the sole visual reference. Show exactly one complete practical one-handed arming sword, retaining its blued steel straight double-edged blade, bronze fishtail crossguard, teal leather wrapped grip, and round bronze pommel with abstract star ornament. Three-quarter view showing solid form, centered with generous margins. Isolated on pure white background. No hands, people, lettering, text, floor, cast shadows, logos or watermark.
constraints: 2D planning only. Equipped cosmetic use is conditional on account ownership and matching weapon; current acquisition is unverified. No model created or inspected; grip, stow, tier and runtime fit are not reviewed.
